remarks:
12-Acre Country Homestead with Spacious Home, Livestock Barn, Workshop & Multiple Outbuildings!

Discover the possibilities of country living on this versatile 12-acre property in Conewango Valley, offering a spacious six-bedroom home, substantial outbuildings, and plenty of room for animals, equipment, hobbies, and outdoor enjoyment.
Built in 1964, the two-story residence offers approximately 2,480 square feet of living space, with a generous floor plan providing flexibility for family living, entertaining, guests, or dedicated home office and hobby spaces.
The property's impressive collection of outbuildings creates opportunities for a variety of agricultural and recreational pursuits. A substantial 107' × 38' livestock barn provides space for horses and smaller livestock, making this an appealing setting for those looking to establish a hobby farm or enjoy a rural lifestyle. A separate 71' × 37' shop offers extensive room for equipment, projects, and workspace, while an additional 42' × 30' storage barn provides valuable covered storage for tractors, implements, recreational vehicles, and other equipment.
A large gravel driveway and parking area provides convenient access to the buildings, with ample room for maneuvering trailers, farm machinery, and larger vehicles.
With 12 acres to enjoy, the property offers room to pursue agricultural interests, accommodate animals, and embrace the freedom of country living. Whether you envision a working homestead, equestrian property, hobby farm, or private countryside retreat, this unique offering combines residential comfort with the space and infrastructure to bring your vision to life.
ADDITIONAL INFORMATION: Buyers agent must be present for showings, GMO and Timber rights convey, Spring, Electric and driveway on site, 4.4 miles to Randolph, 6.5 miles to Cherry Creek, 6.7 miles to Napoli
